_doc: RegisterPush asks the server to post to a URL when something changes, which is how a client that cannot hold a connection open — an app on a phone, say — hears about changes at all. The subscription is not live yet: the server pushes a verification code to the URL first, and ConfirmPush writes it back.

methodCalls._comment: There is no accountId here. A subscription belongs to the credentials that made it, not to an account, so it hears about every account those credentials can see.
